description: verify-keycloak-tls: ingress to Keycloak over TLS with the identity-provider CA. Baseline (listeners, plaintext refusal, CA separation, public metadata and redirects, sign-in, machine token, sign-out), passive capture of the hop, control nginx variants (session reuse, keep-alive, another dialed name, verification off), failure cases (untrusted CA, lab CA, name outside the CA's constraints, expired, excluded subdomain, excluded IP address) with new versus established connections, saved-session resumption, and recovery by renewal without restarts; an isolated control in which the same nginx verifier accepts the keycloak-plus-IP certificate from an unconstrained CA; renewal; log search. Scripted clients only.
